paragraphs.text: Glimmer Vale , also known as "Fool's Gold Gulch" , was a small vale in the hinterlands of Kjeldor , on the continent of Terisiare at the time of the Dominarian Ice Age . The fulch was located at the foot of Raynor Glacier , and contained large amounts of churned-up mica, making it glimmer like gold in the sunshine.

After stealing back Jodah's mirror from Gustha Ebbasdotter in the Royal Academy of Magic in Krov , Jaya Ballard enlisted the skyknight Belenda Danisdotter to bring her to Glimmer Vale, where Jodah was being taken care of.
